Summary:

The call transcript is from a company’s IT helpdesk phone system. The automated prompts guide callers to select options for password reset, account unlock, technology and business application support, or mobile device support. Callers are then asked to enter their 8-digit personnel number for identification. An announcement is made informing callers that there is a high call volume due to widespread performance issues with the “my key” system, which is redirecting users to a phishing warning page when they attempt to log in. The IT team is aware of the problem and actively working to resolve it. Callers are advised not to submit additional tickets or contact the service desk about this issue. Apologies are offered for any inconvenience, and callers are encouraged to visit the company’s tech support website for solutions or alternative contact options. All agents are currently busy, and callers are asked to continue holding if they need further assistance.

After holding, the caller (an employee) is connected to a Service Desk agent. The agent verifies the caller’s identity by requesting their employee number, enterprise ID, and a callback number. The employee explains that they are following up on a previously submitted ticket because their computer will not turn on and they cannot access updates in the portal. The agent confirms the issue and informs the caller that the ticket has already been assigned to the local office, which will reach out directly for further assistance. The call concludes with both parties exchanging thanks and ending the conversation.
